item.title: Review: Suspect arrested in connection with NYC jogger's murder: Police
item.description: The NYPD arrested a man on Saturday in connection with the killing of Katie Suarez, who was stabbed while jogging in Brooklyn last week.

item.title: Review: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
item.description: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was removed from office and placed under house arrest Friday. The Senate voted on his impeachment after the collapse of a state-affiliated bank.
